reviewMethod: Human-visible agent inspection through decoded image outputs; automated QC is reported separately. No claim of continuous real-time playback is made.

preview-9x16.notes: Inspected the decoded one-frame-per-second preview sheet and 14 full representative vertical renders. Corrected subtitle auto-width and stable word padding, rerendered all stills, and verified the revised two-line result. Scene fade frames remain on the warm canvas, not black.

final-9x16.notes: Inspected all 19 decoded one-second frames from the delivered 1080x1920 MP4 and 14 representative vertical renders. Two-line subtitle correction remains intact; no clipping, accidental blank/black scene, or unsafe text was observed.

final-16x9.notes: Inspected all 19 decoded one-second frames from the delivered 1920x1080 MP4 and 14 representative horizontal renders. The horizontal version uses separate left/right or four-column compositions, not a stretched or center-cropped vertical export.
